findings.evidence: Plan M24-05 requires executing the 24 bounded bindings and verifying revoke/abort/finalization without a cumulative gate, but does not distinguish the permitted terminal paths. core/graph_engineering/core/profiles.py:2621 requires the exact combined-gate-consumed decision for successful finalize_after_gate; a partial candidate cannot obtain that decision. Existing tests/support/wp08_release_coverage.py separates abort_uncommitted_coverage_factory from finalize_consumed_coverage_factory.
findings.required_change: Make M24-05 acceptance explicit: bounded real mandatory24 candidates must reject finalization before gate consumption, then close through the exact-capability abort path. Verify successful post-gate finalization separately through an existing bounded synthetic lifecycle regression, without executing cumulative or performance workloads or treating synthetic evidence as release coverage acceptance.
findings.verification: The revised Plan identifies both terminal paths and their evidence boundaries, requires zero gate decision for the real partial candidates, and keeps cumulative execution excluded.
